request.initial_prompt: Cominius. If I should tell thee o'er this thy day's work, Thou't not believe thy deeds. But I'll report it Where senators shall mingle tears with smiles; Where great patricians shall attend and shrug, I' th' end admire; where ladies shall be frighted And, gladly quaked, hear more; where the dull tribunes, That with the fusty plebeians hate thine honours, Shall say against their hearts "We thank the gods Our Rome hath such a soldier." Yet cam'st thou to a morsel of this feast, Having fully dined before.
